column1: # SPECTER Table VII transcription: selected displacement-damage (damage-energy)
# cross sections in keV-barns for 7 spectra, plus the Table II Ed column (eV).
# Source: Greenwood & Smither, "SPECTER: Neutron Damage Calculations for
#   hash-pinned PDF the validation oracle downloads; SHA-256
#   Transcribed 2026-09-16 by reading the report scan pages directly
#   (report p. -31- for Table VII, report p. -14- for the Table II Ed
#   column); the scan's embedded OCR text layer was not trusted for values.
# Columns 2-8 are Table VII as printed (keV-b). The printed "140."-style
#   trailing-point integers are written with an explicit ".0" (value-identical).
#   thermal: (n,gamma) damage only, equals TGAM (Table II) x sigma0 (2200 m/s).
#   fission: 235U fission spectrum average. mev14: average of the SPECTER
#   energy group from 14-15 MeV. hfir/ebr2/fftf/fusion: whole-spectrum
#   averages for HFIR (ORNL, PTP position), EBR-II (ANL-W, Row 2), FFTF
#   (HEDL, MOTA), and the UWMAK first-wall fusion spectrum. Every value is an
#   average over the entire spectrum named.
# Column 9 (ed_ev) is the Table II Ed Lindhard cutoff (eV) for the element.
#   Ag is natural silver (both Table II isotopes, 107Ag and 109Ag, list
#   Ed = 60 eV); W is natural tungsten (all four Table II isotopes list
#   Ed = 90 eV). Displacement cross sections in barns follow the report's own
#   rule: barns = keV-b x 0.8 / (2 x Ed[keV]), Ed from this column or a value
#   of the caller's choice. Gas-production columns are out of scope (v1 is
#   displacement only); the group-wise Appendix A printouts are image-only in
#   the scan and are not transcribed here.
# Rows follow the report order (increasing Z). 24 data rows expected.
